title: Range of the minority indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The minority indicator of $f$ at $x$, defined using the sign of the mean of $f$, lies in the interval $[0,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
